mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting Moth to the desk was most worthwhile: the optional rewrite and preview make user control tangible rather than just a promise.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the printer and then assigning it to the controller felt a little procedural, though the distinction between physical fitting and configuration was clear.

surprise.text: I expected software removal, but inspecting the tablet also led to physically disconnecting its microphone—a more visible privacy measure.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; even the separate printer setup had an explained purpose.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the locally controlled infrastructure holds up, and the practical choices here made privacy and user agency concrete.
